exercises.question: Which sentence correctly expresses an evaluation?
options: Es importante que escuchemos otras opiniones. [It is important that we listen to other opinions.]
Es importante que escuchamos otras opiniones. [It is important that we listen to other opinions.]
Es importante si escuchemos otras opiniones. [It is important if we listen to other opinions.]

exercises.english: It is necessary that everyone can participate.
I think it is good that they participate.

sentences: Primero, el grupo habló del problema. [First, the group talked about the problem.]
Después, todos dieron su opinión. [Then everyone gave their opinion.]
Finalmente, la profesora dijo: «Es importante que todos participen». [Finally, the teacher said: “It is important that everyone participates.”]

exercises.question: Which verb means «to value / assess»?
options: valorar [to value]
preocuparse [to worry]
dudar [to doubt]

exercises.sentence: Es importante ___ el trabajo de otras personas.
exercises.english: It is important to value other people's work.
I am concerned that it affects other people.

exercises.sentence: Es importante que escuchemos otras opiniones.
options: It is important that we listen to other opinions.
It is certain that we listen to other opinions.
We doubt that we listened to other opinions.

exercises.sentence: Me preocupa que afecte a otras personas.
options: I am concerned that it affects other people.
I am certain that it affects other people.
I said that it affected other people.

exercises.english: It is important that everyone speaks.

options: Es necesario que todos participen. [It is necessary that everyone participates.]
Es necesario que todos participan. [It is necessary that everyone participates.]
Es necesario si todos participen. [It is necessary if everyone participates.]
Me preocupa que afecte a otras personas. [I am concerned that it affects other people.]
Me preocupa que afectó a otras personas. [I am concerned that it affected other people.]
Me preocupa si afecte. [I am concerned if it affects.]
Deberíamos valorar las consecuencias. [We should assess the consequences.]
Deberíamos que valorar las consecuencias. [We should that assess the consequences.]
Deberíamos valoras las consecuencias. [We should you assess the consequences.]

template.prompt: Say that it is important that everyone participates.
Say that it worries you that the decision affects other people.
template.answer: Me preocupa que la decisión afecte a otras personas.

template.prompt: Say that it is important that we listen to other opinions because a decision must consider different perspectives.
template.answer: Es importante que escuchemos otras opiniones porque una decisión debe considerar diferentes perspectivas.
